page_title: TOU 1-1 LEN | Toulouse v Lens 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' What a chance that is! Martin Satriano (Lens) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Anass Zaroury (Lens) was quite harsh and Bastien Dechepy didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' Wesley Said (Lens) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
87' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) picks up a yellow card.
81' Substitution. Wesley Said (Lens) on for Goduine Koyalipou.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Tom Pouilly as he is replaced by Florian Sotoca (Lens).
77' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
76' Will Still has decided to substitute Adrien Thomasson and he is replaced by Martin Satriano (Lens).
75' Dangerous play by Aron Donnum (Toulouse). Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul. Lens get a free kick.
70' The substitution is prepared. Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Frank Magri.
70' Warren Kamanzi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse).
68' Will Still is forced to make a change. Deiver Machado (Lens) is unable to continue due to injury, Anass Zaroury comes on.
66' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
63' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
61' 1 - 1 Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) reacts well to a deflected cross from Adrien Thomasson and places a close-range header beyond the keeper into the left of the goal. 1:1.
60' Nampalys Mendy (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.
59' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
57' Facundo Medina (Lens) is cautioned by the referee.
57' Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
51' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Adrien Thomasson (Lens) for his blatant foul.
50' The corner from Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is hurriedly cleared.

50' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Toulouse will take a corner.
47' 1 - 0 Goal! Yann Gboho (Toulouse) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
47' Lens are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

43' The game is interrupted. Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to Lens.
38' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) commits a rough foul. Bastien Dechepy stops the game and makes a call.
36' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
30' Joshua King (Toulouse) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
28' Facundo Medina (Lens) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
24' Joshua King (Toulouse) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) serves up a nice cross, but Mathew Ryan punches the ball away.
21' Frank Magri (Toulouse) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
17' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
10' Joshua King (Toulouse) latched onto a loose pass on the edge of the box and let fly, but Mathew Ryan saw it all the way and made a fine save to deny him.
4' Guillaume Restes is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Tom Pouilly (Lens), pushing the ball around the post to safety.
1' The first half has started.
Toulouse will kick the game off.
Bastien Dechepy is the one to supervise the game today.
